ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the web performance test. It is recommended to investigate the cause of the failure and optimize the page to improve its load time.
insights: The pricing page has the fastest load time of all the pages tested, indicating effective optimization.
The blog page has a longer load time than the pricing page, suggesting that there may be opportunities to further optimize the blog page.
The ttfb (time to first byte) metric is consistently low across all pages, indicating that the server response time is fast. This is a positive sign of good web performance.
